plugins.evidence: Limited to GitHub Apps extensions marketplace.

embeddings.evidence: Simple vector indexing for repository indexing.

enterpriseSecurity.evidence: SOC2, IP exclusion filters, copyright indemnity guarantees.

ideIntegration.evidence: Universal compatibility across multiple IDE engines.
